msd_swinunetr.learning_rate_policy: Preserve baseline LR trajectory with fixed 610-update horizon, irrespective of objective or stopping cap. AdamW0.0001, 5% horizon warmup, then cosine to1% initial LR.
msd_swinunetr.patient_identity_scope: Ten volume IDs, disjoint from52 validation volume IDs; original-MRI patient mapping unavailable.

msd_unetr_vit_b16.learning_rate_policy: Preserve baseline LR trajectory with fixed 477-update horizon, irrespective of objective or stopping cap. AdamW0.0001, 5% horizon warmup, then cosine to1% initial LR.
msd_unetr_vit_b16.patient_identity_scope: Ten volume IDs, disjoint from52 validation volume IDs; original-MRI patient mapping unavailable.

adni_swinunetr.learning_rate_policy: Frozen MSD trajectory: original warmup/cosine or nnU-Net polynomial, with unchanged horizon
adni_swinunetr.constraint_geometry: Binary hippocampus; 2-step bands; original signed face edge; full-volume half-voxel SDF clipped at 8 voxels. Depth uses 2-voxel bins in an 8-voxel ROI; plane normal is array axis 0 projected off GT PC1. Source anatomical orientation and physical spacing are unavailable; no mm interpretation.

adni_unetr_vit_b16.learning_rate_policy: Frozen MSD trajectory: original warmup/cosine or nnU-Net polynomial, with unchanged horizon
adni_unetr_vit_b16.constraint_geometry: Binary hippocampus; 2-step bands; original signed face edge; full-volume half-voxel SDF clipped at 8 voxels. Depth uses 2-voxel bins in an 8-voxel ROI; plane normal is array axis 0 projected off GT PC1. Source anatomical orientation and physical spacing are unavailable; no mm interpretation.

limitations: Current MNI pilot is one fold and seed; historical comparisons have nine runs per model.
External means foreground/background confusion, not measured distance to a boundary.
Voxel error shares are not additive contributions to macro Dice.
No spatial predictions/checkpoints retained; prior spatial probes used different interrupted 8x runs.
No new training, validation tuning, or causal ablation performed by this analysis.
MNI is the evaluated new dataset here; these results do not establish causes for COBRA.
